name: Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3), baking soda
source: NaHCO3 molar mass 84.006 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (Na 22.990, H 1.008, C 12.011, O 15.999 x3).
notes: Food-grade baking soda is essentially pure NaHCO3. Na, H and C are rounded to the nearest microgram; O absorbs the remainder so the four-element compound closes exactly. This is the leavening salt whose decomposition (2 NaHCO3 -> Na2CO3 + H2O + CO2) releases the CO2 that a leavening process must draw from here and post to atmosphere, never invent.
